```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r five percent cutoff}
#observed value = posterior mean 
obs_df <- real_loglik %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(Obs_LL = mean(LogLikelihood), .groups = "drop")

#gene-specific 5% lower-tail cutoff from the simulated distribution
cutoff_df <- sim_loglik %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(Cutoff_05 = quantile(LogLikelihood, 0.05), .groups = "drop")

#join and flag 
ll_screen_mean <- obs_df %>%
  inner_join(cutoff_df, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(Below_05 = Obs_LL <= Cutoff_05)

#summary 
ll_screen_mean %>%
  summarise(
    Genes_total = n(),
    Genes_below = sum(Below_05),
    Prop_below = mean(Below_05)
  )
```
